results.name: How to Manage Your Digital Listings
results.title: How to Manage Your Digital Listings
results.body:
Digital items come in two categories: 

  • Instant downloads: Ready-made files that the buyer can access immediately upon purchase
  • Made-to-order downloads: Custom files made to a buyer’s specification that will be sent to them upon completion.

Like handmade items, digital items listed in your store must be made and/or designed by you, the seller.

Follow the instructions to list an item on Etsy and choose Digital files under the What type of item is it? prompt. To create a made-to-order digital listing: 

  1. Go to the When did you make it? dropdown.
  2. Select Made To Order.

How to add files to your digital listing

When listing a digital item that is an instant download, you’ll need to upload the files that the buyer is purchasing when you create the listing. You can upload up to five digital files. The maximum size for each file is 20MB.

  • .bmp
  • .doc
  • .gif
  • .jpeg
  • .jpg
  • .mobi
  • .mov
  • .mp3
  • .mpeg
  • .pdf
  • .png
  • .psp
  • .rtf
  • .stl
  • .txt
  • .zip
  • .ePUB
  • .iBook

Uploaded files will appear in a list with their names, file sizes, and upload dates. The file names you see will be the same ones your buyers see. We don't have a way of editing the name after uploading, so be sure to name your files appropriately first.

File names are limited to 70 alphanumeric characters, periods, underscores, or hyphens.

Add a note for buyers

You can add a note for buyers that will apply to all digital listings purchased from your shop. After a purchase, a buyer can see the note on their Downloads page.

Can I offer variations for my digital items?

No, you can’t offer variations for digital items.

How can I change the file attached to an instant digital listing?

To remove a file, select the X icon next to its file name when you create or edit a listing, and add new files to the listing using the Add files button. You will be unable to publish or save an instant digital listing if there is no file attached to it. Canceling an order is the only way to revoke a buyer’s access to a file after it has been purchased. 

If I exclusively sell digital items, will I be eligible for Star Seller?

Yes, if you sell only digital items, you’re still eligible for Star Seller. When you view your Star Seller dashboard you won’t see an on-time shipping & tracking score, but you’ll still be considered based on other metrics.

How to complete made-to-order digital orders

Unlike instant downloads, you don’t upload a file when creating a made-to-order digital listing. Once you’re ready to send the finished file to the buyer, complete the order through the following steps:

  1. On Etsy.com, go to your Shop Manager and select Orders. 
  2. Your incomplete orders are displayed under the New tab. 
  3. Check the box of the order you want to finish, then choose Complete order. 
  4. Select the Upload file button. You can attach up to five files with a maximum size of 20MB each.
  5. Finish by selecting the Complete order button. The buyer will be notified by email that their order is now available for download.

results.name: How to Edit Your Listing Photos
results.title: How to Edit Your Listing Photos
results.body:
Did you know you can add videos of your items? Learn how to attract shoppers with listing videos.

When you add photos to your listings, you can change their order, crop them, edit them, and adjust the thumbnail. The thumbnail is a cropped version of your primary listing photo that may be seen in different places across Etsy.

Having multiple clear, high-resolution images in your listing is an important factor for your listings’ quality. Having a main image that is too dark, blurry, or are part of a photo-collage may result in your listing appearing lower in Etsy search results.  

  • Learn more about Etsy’s Customer Service Standards.
  • Learn more about requirements for listing photos.

While your listing photos upload to the Etsy Seller app, you can complete the remaining listing information. You'll receive a notification if any of your photos failed to upload and you need to try again. Once your photos have successfully uploaded, you can begin to edit them.

How to change the order of your listing photos

The first photo will be the thumbnail for your listing. You can change the order of your photos on your listing if you’d like a different one to be first.

  1. On Etsy.com, open Shop Manager.
  2. Choose Listings.
  3. Edit your listing or create a new listing.
  4. After you’ve added at least 2 images to the Photos section, select and drag them to change the order.

  1. Open the listing and tap a photo or the Listing heading.
  2. Tap View all.
  3. Tap Reorder.
  4. Tap and drag a photo.
  5. Choose Save.

How to crop your listing photos

You can crop your photos after you add them to your listing. Cropping can change how the thumbnail looks, so try cropping before adjusting your thumbnail.

  1. Open Shop Manager.
  2. Choose Listings.
  3. Edit your listing or create a new listing.
  4. Hover over the photo.
  5. Choose the crop icon.
  6. Select any one of the suggested sizes or drag the grid's corners to choose your own size.
  7. Select Save.

  1. Open your listing and tap a listing photo.
  2. Tap Edit.
  3. Drag the corners to resize the image or choose Original for preset sizes.
  4. Slide the image to choose what part you want to display.
  5. Tap Apply.

You won’t be able to undo the crop after you save it. To undo the crop, upload the original image again.

How to edit your listing photos

Etsy has partnered with Img.ly so you can edit your listing photos on the Etsy Seller app with just a few taps.

  1. In Listings, select the listing you wish to edit or create a new one. 
  2. Go to Photo and video and select the photo or videos you wish to edit, or add a new one. Select Edit.
  3. Select Transform to crop or rotate, or Adjust to edit brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, and more. 
  4. Select the check mark in the top right corner when finished editing.

If you have preferred photo edits, save them as a custom photo filter. Saving your custom photo filters can make editing easier and help give your listing photos a cohesive look.

  1. After editing your listing image, select Create a filter to save it.
  2. Provide your custom photo filter with a name under Filter name.
  3. Select Save.

  1. When editing an image, select Apply a photo filter. 
  2. Choose the filter you want from your list of custom photo filters.

Your custom photo filters will show up in order from most to least recently used. 

If you delete a custom photo filter, the images that have been edited with the filter will not be impacted.

How to adjust your thumbnail

  1. Open Shop Manager.
  2. Choose Listings.
  3. Edit your listing or create a new listing.
  4. Choose Adjust Thumbnail.
  5. Slide the circular button left and right to zoom in and out.
  6. Position your image so your subject is clear in all 3 views used across Etsy.
  7. Select Apply.

How to fix your listings’ images for Etsy search visibility  

To view which of your listings have images that may be causing Etsy search visibility problems: 

  1. From your Shop Manager, visit your Etsy Search visibility page. 
  2. In the Your listings section, you’ll see personalized insights and recommendations on how to improve your listings. 
  3. Choose an issue you want to correct and select View listings. This shows all the listings in your shop with that issue. 
  4. Multiple issues may affect an individual listing. Once all the issues are resolved, they will no longer appear in your Etsy Search visibility page. 

 Once improvements have been made, the insights will typically disappear within 24 hours.

results.name: How to Add a Text Alternative to Your Listing Images
results.title: How to Add a Text Alternative to Your Listing Images
results.body:
Etsy might add alt text to US seller’s listing images to make them more accessible to users with disabilities. Images that already have alt text added will not be altered by Etsy. Alt text added by Etsy can be edited at any time.

Text alternative (or “alt text”) provides an image description to buyers who can’t see what you’re showing in your listing images. If your default shop language is set to English, you can add an image description for each of your listing images so that your content is accessible to blind and low-vision individuals.

These descriptions don’t appear visually on the page. Adding a text alternative to your listing images also means that search engines outside of Etsy can read your listing images and might also positively impact your listings’ SEO (Search Engine Optimization).

To edit the text alternative of your listing images on Etsy.com:

  1. Sign in to Etsy.com and go to Shop Manager.
  2. Select Listings.
  3. Select a listing.
  4. Select the photo you want to add alternative text to.
  5. In the Alt text section, describe your listing’s image in detail.
  6. Choose Apply.

You can add a description for as many images as you want.

To edit the text alternative of your listing images on the Etsy Seller app: 

  1. Sign in to the Etsy Seller app and go to Listings. 
  2. Select a listing. 
  3. In the Listing tab, select the pencil icon in the Photo and video section. 
  4. Select the Alt text icon. 
  5. Choose the image you want to add alt text to.  
  6. Describe your listing’s image in detail.
  7. Choose Save.

How to write a great image description

Follow these best practices to describe your images in text alternatives:

  • Describe the item’s details: what it looks like, the texture, the scale in relation to other items in your photograph.
  • Think about what buyers would lose out on if your images didn’t load on the page.
  • Keep the description concise: up to 250 characters.

Examples of text alternative


Photo by MijMojDesign

Text alternative: Watch display holder rests on a table, made of a long, wooden block base with 3 thick round columns sticking up enough for a watch band to sit sideways. Customizable text etched into the block base. Watch dial etched into top of the middle column.


Photo by AleishlaLopez

Text alternative: Earrings shaped like tall, thin arches hang far down the model’s neck. Between the arch columns hang a string of small mother of pearl droplets. The pearl droplets are free-hanging and are attached with metal links that match the arch. 

How do I describe size charts?

Describe the sizing chart image in as much detail as possible. An alternate method to include sizing charts in your listing is to put sizing charts in your listing description.

What happens if I don’t add text alternatives to my images?

If you don’t provide a text alternative to describe an image, Etsy will automatically add a description to your listing using AI generated text. If you don’t want Etsy to automatically add alt text to your listing images, manually add your own alt text to your listings.

Should I add text alternatives to all of my images?

It is especially beneficial to describe different views, details, or variations of your listing. If you provide different descriptions, each image will have different alt text for blind and low vision individuals to further understand what each of your images is showing.

What impacts my SEO?

Adding your shop name, listing title, listing description, or other attributes (tags, SKUs, etc.) to the alt text won’t be an additional benefit to your listing’s SEO as these items are already part of your shop or listing pages. Alt text is used to describe the photo for someone who cannot see it – this can include search engine bots. Learn more about how you can use SEO for your shop.

results.name: How to Download a Digital Item
results.title: How to Download a Digital Item
results.body:
Quick answer

Digital items you’ve purchased can be viewed and downloaded from the Purchases section of your Etsy account.

If you have questions about an item or order, your seller is the best person to help you.

Contact seller

There are 2 kinds of digital purchases: 

  • Instant downloads: Ready-made files that are available once your payment is confirmed. If you paid with PayPal or a credit card on Etsy, it may take a few minutes for your download link to be sent to you. 
  • Made-to-order downloads: Digital items that the seller will make to your specifications after you purchase them. The seller will send your files to you once they have completed them. 

When your digital files are available for download, you will receive an email. Select View your files on Etsy to be taken to the Purchases section of your Etsy account to download files.

You can't download a digital purchase through the Etsy app at this time. To download a digital file, please sign in to Etsy on your mobile browser or computer.

I can’t find my download notification email

First, check your spam or junk inbox. If you use Gmail, also check your Social and Promotions tabs. If it’s not there, adding transaction@account.etsy.com or noreply@etsy.com to your address book or safe list can help you locate these emails in the future.

For now, you can still access your digital purchases in your account.

Where can I find my digital purchases in my account?

To access your digital files from your account:

  1. Sign in to Etsy.com and go to Your account.
  2. Go to Purchases.
  3. Next to the order, select Download Files. This goes to the Downloads page for all the files attached to your order.

You can also select View Receipt at the top of an item’s listing page to go to Purchases, where you can download the item.

There are generally no limits for when or how many times you can download a file. In most cases, you can access a file any time on your Purchases page, provided the transaction hasn't been canceled or removed.

If your payment is still processing, the Download Files button will be gray.

When will I receive my made-to-order digital item? 

The delivery window for made-to-order digital items depends on the seller. Please coordinate with the seller through Messages to establish the completion time for your order. 

To see the status of your made-to-order digital item, go to the Purchases  section of your Etsy account. Items that the seller is still working on are shown as In progress. 

Once the seller finishes your order, you will receive an email with a link to download your digital file. You can also access your files by going to Purchases and selecting the Download files button. You will be able to leave a review for your purchase after you download your file.

I purchased a digital item, but I don't have an Etsy account

If you purchased an instant digital download as a guest, you'll find a link to download your files in the receipt email that was sent to you after the purchase. 

Made-to-order digital items will be sent once the seller has finished them. If you no longer have access to the email account you used to make the original purchase, please contact the seller directly to discuss how they can send you your files.

I’m having trouble downloading my files

If nothing happens when you click the download links, it’s possible that there’s an issue with your web browser. Please disable any non-standard add-ons like ad blockers or toolbars that you’ve installed and try again.

If your computer states that the file has been corrupted, delete the file and try downloading it again. If you still can't open the file, please contact the seller through Etsy Messages for further assistance.

The type of file you’ll be downloading is shown under the Highlights section of a digital listing. If your computer is unable to open the file, it’s possible that you’re missing the program required to open the file type. 

If you continue to have trouble, contact Etsy Support.

My download is a ZIP file

Some digital items are delivered as a ZIP file, which bundles one or more files into a single download. Before you can use the files inside, you'll need to unzip (or extract) the folder.

To unzip a ZIP file: 

  • On a computer: Double-click the ZIP file or right-click it and select Extract.
  • On a phone or tablet: You may need to use your device's file manager or a compatible app to unzip the file. It’s not possible to download any digital items through the Etsy app at this time.

If you're unable to open the files after unzipping them, you may need software that's compatible with that file type. Check the listing’s description to see if there’s file type information, any software requirements, or instructions provided by the seller. If you're still unable to open the files, contact the seller for help.

I want a refund or want to cancel my digital item

On the item page for a digital listing, you will see that digital listings are not able to be returned or canceled.

If there’s a problem with your digital order, like it’s not as described in the listing or the seller never delivers the file, you may be covered under Etsy’s Purchase Protection. 

 Learn how to get help with your order.

results.title: How to Download Your Listing Information
results.body:
To download your listing data:

  1. Sign in to Etsy.com.
  2. Click the You, then click Shop Manager.
  3. Click Settings.
  4. Click Options.
  5. Click Download Data.
  6. Click Download CSV to save the file to your computer.

You can also download your monthly statements and sold order history as CSV files.

What data is included in my listing CSV?

The listing data CSV file you download includes the following information for your active listings: 

  • Title 
  • Description 
  • Price 
  • Currency code 
  • Quantity 
  • Tags 
  • Materials 
  • Image URLs
  • SKU numbers (if you've added any to your listings)

The CSV format can be imported into most spreadsheet applications, including Excel, Numbers, and Google Spreadsheets.

results.name: Requirements and Best Practices for Images in Your Etsy Shop
results.title: Requirements and Best Practices for Images in Your Etsy Shop
results.body:
When uploading images to your Etsy shop, follow these guidelines:

Jump to a section:

  • File type requirements
  • Image size requirements
  • Image authenticity requirements
  • How to resize images
  • Listing image best practices

Check out our Ultimate Guide to Product Photography for image inspiration and recommendations.

If your listing contains images of minors, make sure they comply with our policy.

File type requirements

All images in your shop should be one of these file types: .jpg, .gif, .png, .svg, or .heic. These are the only image file types Etsy supports. 

Animated .gif files & transparent .png files are not supported. If a file contains transparency, the transparent parts of the image will appear black on Etsy. 

Image size requirements

Learn about the size recommendations and requirements for each type of image:

  • Listing images
  • Logo
  • Profile photo
  • Team logo
  • Order receipt banner
  • Mini shop banner
  • Big shop banner
  • Carousel banner
  • Collage banner

Sellers can get a three-month Adobe Express Premium plan trial to help create professional-looking images for your Etsy shop.

Reach out to Adobe's support team if you need any assistance using their services.

Listing images

We recommend your listing photos have a width and height of at least 2000 pixels or more. Your first listing photo should have a width and height of at least 635 pixels to avoid showing up lower in searches.

You can usually find an image’s dimensions and resolution in the image details on your phone or on your computer.

Images larger than 1MB in file size may not finish uploading, especially on a slower internet connection. If you're finding that your photo uploads are taking longer than normal, follow these troubleshooting steps.

Logo 

The recommended size for logos is 500 x 500px. Learn more about uploading a logo.

Profile photo

The recommended size for profile photos is 400 x 400px. Learn more about uploading a profile photo.

Team logo

The recommended size for team logos is 170 x 100px.

Learn more about Etsy Teams.

Order receipt banner

The minimum required size for order receipt banner photos is 760 x 100px. Learn more about uploading an order receipt banner here.

Mini shop banner

The minimum required size for mini shop banners is 1200 x 160px. The recommended size is 1600 x 213px. Learn more about uploading a mini shop banner here.

Big shop banner

The minimum required size for big shop banners is 1200 x 300px. The recommended size is 1600 x 400px.  Learn more about uploading a big shop banner here.

Carousel banner

The recommended size for carousel banners is 1200 x 300px. Learn more about uploading a carousel banner here.

Collage banner

The size recommendation depends on the number of images you want in your collage:

  • For 2 images, the minimum required size is 600 x 300px.
  • For 3 images, the minimum required size is 400 x 300px.
  • For 4 images, the minimum required size is 300 x 300px.

The carousel and collage banners are only available to sellers subscribed to Etsy Plus. Learn more about Etsy Plus.

Image authenticity requirements

Your listing images should help buyers understand exactly what they will receive:

  • All images must accurately reflect the item’s true appearance, including color, condition, scale, and materials. 
  • Your listing must include at least one unedited photo of the actual item against a real background, meaning the photo hasn’t been edited or changed in any way. Some exceptions may apply depending on the types of items you sell.
  • Outside of your required unedited photo, you can still use photo-editing tools, including AI, to adjust lighting or color, crop or resize images, or change backgrounds.
  • You can't use editing to hide flaws, conceal damage, or edit an item’s appearance to make it look different from what the buyer will receive. 
  • You can’t use images that create false expectations about what the buyer will receive. 
  • If you sell functional guides like patterns, recipes, or instructions, you’ll also need to show an actual result made using your instructions, not an AI-generated or simulated result, so buyers know what to expect.

Beyond these requirements, here are a few best practices to keep in mind when using AI in your listings:

  • Make your first listing photo the clearest, most realistic representation of the item buyers will receive. Because it’s the first image buyers see, take extra care to make sure it accurately represents your item and isn’t misleading.
  • If you use AI to edit any of your listing photos, note whether images were edited in your listing description. This gives buyers more context about how your listing images were created and helps you be transparent about your use of AI.

Learn more about these requirements and rules for print-on-demand, customized, made-to-order, digital items, and more.

How to resize images

You can find websites that help you resize images online. Use a website, Photoshop, or a similar software to resize your images.

If you decrease the size of an image, it won’t lower the resolution. However, if you increase the size of an image, you may lose resolution and pixelation may occur.

Images may appear less sharp after being uploaded due to compression of the image files. We do this in order to improve the overall performance of the page. Image sizes are optimized for mobile displays.

Color mode & profile

If your image appears in the wrong colors on Etsy.com, convert your images to sRGB using an image editing software before uploading to ensure that the colors you see on the site will match the originals. We convert images to use the sRGB color profile (CMYK color profile is for print only).

Listing image best practices

Great listing images help you convert shoppers to buyers. Follow these recommendations to optimize your listing images:

  • Image orientation
  • Image rotation
  • Listing image thumbnails
  • Tips for listing images

Image orientation

The first photo in a listing should be horizontal (landscape) or square. This ensures that the center focal point of the image appears in the cropped thumbnail views.

Your first listing photo also dictates the shape of the photos that follow. Uploading the same shape photos for all listing photos will create a more cohesive browsing experience.

Image rotation

Etsy auto-rotates listing photos, but keep in mind that this depends on information included by your camera in the image file. 

If your listing images are still uploading sideways, try using a photo editing service to rotate your images, or retake the photo while holding the camera in a different position. Remember that the orientation of your subject matter should match the orientation of the camera.

Listing image thumbnails

When creating or editing a listing, use the listing thumbnail adjustment tool to set and preview how your listing image may look in different places across Etsy. Make sure that your thumbnail images have enough of a border that they can be cropped to square, portrait, and landscape thumbnails without losing some of the product.

Our recommendations are:

  • Try to capture images of your item further back than you think you’ll need. This will give you the ability to crop in without losing parts of your item. Make sure the most important part of the item is focused in the center. 
  • Position your image so your subject is clear in all 3 views used across Etsy.
  • Avoid square crops. Upload horizontal or landscape images.

Tips for listing images

Take your original picture from a far enough vantage point where you can see the entire product with extra negative space around your product.

Taking horizontally oriented picture means you’re able to use more of the available space within the thumbnail frame. Vertical images will require more information to be cropped out. 

Use the placement tool when adding images to your listings to perform fine-tuning adjustments on what appears within your thumbnail on your listing. 

Your final image will most likely be cropped down from the original image that was initially created. Confirming the image was produced at the highest resolution would be advised to meet the minimum suggested size for listing images.

results.name: How Do Etsy’s Listing Image Requirements Apply to My Listings?
results.title: How Do Etsy’s Listing Image Requirements Apply to My Listings?
results.body:
Listing images should accurately represent the items you're selling so buyers know what to expect when they make a purchase.

Etsy requires at least one unedited photo for most items. For other images, you can use photo editing tools, including AI, as long as your images accurately represent what buyers will receive.

Learn more about Listing Image Requirements.

Jump to a section:

  • What counts as an unedited photo?
  • Does every listing photo need to be unedited?
  • Can I use AI to edit my listing photos?
  • What is Etsy’s policy on AI-generated art or products?
  • What if I sell digital downloads or personalized items?
  • What happens if Etsy detects AI-generated images when I’m creating a listing?
  • What happens if someone reports my listing for potentially misusing AI?

What counts as an unedited photo?

An unedited photo should show the actual item against a real background and must not be edited or changed in any way. Some exceptions may apply depending on the types of items you sell. All your listing photos must accurately represent what the buyer will receive. Outside of your required unedited photo, you can use photo-editing tools, including AI, to adjust lighting or color, crop or resize images, or change backgrounds, as long as those edits don’t make the item appear different.

Does every listing photo need to be unedited?

For most items, you only need at least one real, unedited photo of your item against a real background. You can use photo editing tools in your other listing photos, as long as the edits don't misrepresent what buyers will receive.

Make your first listing photo the clearest, most realistic representation of the item buyers will receive. Because it’s the first image buyers see, take extra care to make sure it accurately represents your item and isn’t misleading.

Can I use AI to edit my listing photos?

Apart from your unedited photo, you can use AI-assisted tools to crop or resize images, adjust lighting or color, or change backgrounds. These edits are allowed as long as they accurately represent your item. Don’t use AI to hide damage or change an item's appearance in a way that could mislead buyers.

What is Etsy’s policy on AI-generated art or products?

Etsy has long supported new technologies that help people bring their ideas to life, as long as human creativity remains central to the process. That's why we allow AI-generated art when sellers play a clear creative role in what they create and are transparent about their process. Sellers must still disclose when an item is created using AI and cannot misrepresent AI-generated work as handmade or entirely their own creation. Learn more.

What if I sell digital downloads or personalized items?

Requirements may differ depending on what you sell:

  • Print-on-demand items: If a production partner prints your original design on a standard base product (like a t-shirt or mug), you may use a stock photo mockup, if the stock photo’s owner has authorized its use.
  • Digital downloads: If your item has a visual component, such as a printable or template, include a preview of the actual content buyers will receive. For digital items without a visual component, you may use representative imagery, including AI-generated images, as long as it doesn't mislead buyers about what they’re purchasing.
  • Customized or made-to-order items: For customized items you make yourself, use photos of real, finished items you’ve made in the past to help buyers see the quality of your work.
  • Craft patterns, recipes, seeds, or similar items: Include at least one real, unedited photo of something made using your product. AI-generated images cannot be the only images used to show the finished result.

Learn more about requirements for specific item types.

What happens if Etsy detects AI-generated images when I’m creating a listing?

If AI-generated images are detected when you create a listing, we will provide tips to help you accurately represent your item and meet our photo expectations.

What happens if someone reports my listing for potentially misusing AI?

In the beginning, these reports will help us better understand how buyers perceive potential AI misuse and won’t result in immediate enforcement action. We’ll continue investing in detection and enforcement tools as we learn more about how AI is being used across Etsy.

results.name: How to Protect Listing Images
results.title: How to Protect Listing Images
results.body:
Any time you upload a photo publicly to the Internet, it comes with a risk. To help protect your images, we recommend following these tips.

  • If you are selling 2D prints or original artwork, you can use photos of the actual print or work, instead of the digital file or a close-up image. For example, you could use a photo of your print hanging on a wall.

  • Upload images that are around 1500 pixels wide. This creates an image large enough to view without blurring, but small enough that a viewer won't be able to save a larger, higher quality file.

  • Incorporate your brand into your images. While some sellers use watermarks, we generally wouldn’t recommend them. Using watermarks makes photos unsuitable for features within Etsy (like Etsy Finds emails), and ineligible for off-site advertising programs like Google Shopping. Instead of watermarking, if you have a brand associated with your shop — whether it's a logo, a specific font for your shop name, or a packaging style — try including it within your listing image (but not as an overlay). This way everyone will know who made the item.

results.title: How to Add Variations to Your Listings
results.body:
If you offer different options for an item within the same listing, you can add those options as variations. For example, if you sell a dress with different sizes and colors, you can specify these options in that dress listing’s variations.

When a buyer purchases from you, you'll see the variations they selected in your Sold Orders, receipts, and transaction notification emails.

  • How to add variations to a listing
  • How to add photos for your variations

How to add variations to a listing

You can add variations for up to 3 item attributes while creating or editing a listing. Separate choices like size, color, and style into distinct variations instead of combining them.

To add variations:

  1. Choose the listing you’re interested in on the Listings page.
  2. Under Item options, select Add variation.
  3. Select from the list of available variations. The variations displayed depend on the category you selected for your listing. 
  4. If you want to vary the price, quantity, processing profile, or SKU numbers for your variation, toggle those options on.
  5. Choose Done.
  6. The variations you create appear under Variations. If you chose to vary on price, quantity, processing profile, or SKU, those options appear next to the variation.

To change the price, processing profile, or quantity of a variation, check the box next to the variation(s) you want to edit, then choose Update price, Update processing, or Update quantity.

Varying on price

The price you set for each option is the total price for each version of the item, not an additional cost.

If you’re a seller outside the US and India, learn how to set up different variation prices for orders shipping domestically and internationally.

Varying on size

For measurement variations, such as length or size, choose a sizing scale. Once you select a unit of measurement, specify the options you offer.

How to add photos for your variations

If this listing varies on a visible attribute, such as color, you can add photos to show that variation.

To add photos for your variations:

  1. Find the listing you want to edit on the Listings page.
  2. Add a new photo in the Photos and video section. You can add up to ten photos.
  3. Go to Variations. Add variations, if you haven’t already.
  4. Select Manage variations.
  5. Choose the pencil icon of the variation you want to add photos to. 
  6. Toggle Link photos to this variation to on. If you have more than 20 options, you can only add photos for 20 of these options.
  7. Choose Select photo for each variation and choose the photo you want to link to that variation. Buyers see this photo when selecting the variation from your shop. 
  8. Choose Done.
  9. Choose Apply. 

How to create custom variations

To add a variation that isn't included in the default list of options, you can create a new variation. However, buyers won’t be able to filter their Etsy search results based on custom variations.

To create a new variation: 

  1. From the Item options tab, choose Manage variations. 
  2. Select Add variation. 
  3. Choose Create your own. 
  4. Enter a name for your variation, toggle if you want to link photos to it, then enter the options you want to offer. 
  5. Choose Done. 
  6. Choose Apply. You can now edit it from the Item options tab. 

How to hide an option

If you don't want an option to be viewable to buyers, edit the listing, go to Variations, and toggle off Visible. You must have at least one option visible. 

If you set the quantity for one of your options to “0”, it will appear on the listing page as Sold out.

How variations work for buyers

If you have variations on a listing, buyers must select the options they want before adding your item to their cart.

If a buyer happened to add your item to their cart before you added variations to the item, they won't be prompted to select your options when they check out.

If you subscribe to Etsy Plus, shoppers can request an email notification for when a sold out item is back in stock. Learn more about restock requests.

Can I offer variations for digital listings?

Listing variations are not currently supported for digital item listings.

Should I use variations or personalization?

Use variations when buyers are choosing from a set list of options that impact price, inventory, or SKU (like size, color, or material). 

Use personalization when buyers are adding custom details. Learn more.

Variation limitations

To help keep Etsy’s website loading quickly for buyers, some limits apply to listings with many variation options:

  • Listings with 3 variation types can have up to 2,500 option combinations.
  • Listings with 1-2 variation types can have up to 4,900 option combinations.
  • You can set unique or country-specific prices, SKUs, and quantities for up to 400 option combinations.

An option combination is a unique version of your item created by your variation choices. For example, if your listing offers 10 sizes, 25 colors, and 10 materials, it has 2,500 option combinations (10 × 25 × 10).

results.name: How to Offer Personalized Listings
results.title: How to Offer Personalized Listings
results.body:
Add Custom options fields to your listings so buyers can personalize the items they purchase. Personalization lets buyers tell you what they’d like customized, like a name for engraving or a special message.
For the buyer, the fields appear on the listing alongside options like color or quantity. You can see the Custom options information a buyer adds on the Orders page.

Jump to a section:

  • How to add Custom options fields to listings
  • What to include in Custom options instructions
  • How to set add-on pricing for Text box fields
  • How to photograph personalized listings
  • When to offer personalizations, variations, or custom listings

How to add Custom options fields to listings

When creating a listing, use Custom options to define the information you want buyers to provide for personalized or customized orders.

You can add up to 5 fields per listing. Each field should focus on a single detail. A simpler setup—using fewer, well-defined fields—can make it easier for buyers to complete their order and provide what you need.

  1. Sign in and go to Shop Manager.
  2. Choose Listings and select a listing you want to add personalization to.
  3. Under Item options, go to Custom options and select Add field.
  4. Select the field type you want to add and enter the requested information.
    • Select Text box to collect information like names, dates, quotes. 
    • Select List of options to create a list of choices to select from, like fonts and thread colors. 
    • Select File upload to collect images and files from buyers.
  5. Check or uncheck This field is required. 
  6. Choose Done.

  1. Sign in and go to Listings.
  2. Select the listing you want to add personalization to.
  3. Select Custom options, then the field type you want to add and enter the requested information.
    • Select Text box to collect information like names, dates, quotes. 
    • Select List of options to create a list of choices to select from, like fonts and thread colors. 
    • Select File upload to collect images and files from buyers.
  4. Check or uncheck This field is required. 
  5. Choose Done.

To edit a field, select Edit. To delete individual fields, select Delete. 

  1. Go to Listings.
  2. Check the box next to each listing you’d like to edit. 
  3. Go to Editing Options. 
  4. Choose Change Custom options.
  5. Add or edit your fields, then select Apply.

If you enable File upload personalization, content that is submitted by buyers must comply with Etsy’s Buyer Policy. If you’re concerned about a submission, contact Support.

What to include in Custom options instructions

Clear instructions help buyers provide the details you need to complete their order. When creating fields:

  • Use clear titles that describe what buyers should provide.
  • Request one detail per field whenever possible.
  • Explain how or where the personalization will appear on the item.
  • Provide an example when helpful.
  • Include limits, such as character counts or file requirements.

Use this table to decide which field type(s) works best for your listing:

Use a Text box when buyers need to add custom text, like names, dates, or short messages.

Include: 

  • A specific field title that describes what to enter (avoid generic titles like “Personalization”)
  • Instructions explaining how or where the text will appear
  • A character limit (1–1024), based on your design 
  • Whether the field is required or optional for buyers to complete


Examples of clear, informational Text box fields for a personalized birthday card: 

  1. Title: Name
    Instructions: Enter the name you want to appear on the front of the card [Example: Clifton]
  2. Title: Age
    Instructions: Enter the number you want to appear on the front of the card [Example: 80]
  3. Title: Message for inside (optional)
    Instructions: Enter the text you would like to appear on the inside of the card

Use a List of options when buyers choose from predefined selections like font styles, design variations, or materials. 
You can include up to 30 options. Keeping your list shorter (for example, 10 or fewer options) can make it easier for buyers to choose and complete their purchase. 

Include: 

  • A field title describing the selection
  • One detail per option
  • A logical ordering, if options follow a sequence
  • Whether the field is required or optional for buyers to complete

Examples of clear, informational List of options fields for a monogrammed sweatshirt: 

  1. Title: Font style (see examples in photo)
    Options: Font 1, Font 2, Font 3, etc. 
  2. Title: Text color
    Options: Black, White, Blue, Red

Use a File upload field when buyers need to upload files, like photos, logos, or artwork.

You can add one upload field per listing. Buyers can upload up to 10 files, with a maximum size of 100 MB per file. Supported file types are .jpg, .png, .svg, .heic, and .pdf.

Include: 

  • A specific field title describing what to upload
  • The number of files
  • Labels, as needed, to identify different files when requesting multiple uploads
  • Instructions explaining what the file should show
  • Whether the field is required or optional for buyers to complete

Use labels when you need buyers to upload different files for specific purposes (for example, “Front of item” and “Back of item”). Labels help clarify what each file should show. If you don’t need different types of files, you can leave labels off and have buyers upload all files together in one place.

The required or optional setting applies to the entire file upload field, not individual labels.

If the field is marked as required, buyers must upload a file for each label before they can check out.

Example of clear, informational File upload field for a locket: 

  1. Title: Pet photos
    Number of files allowed: 2
    Label 1: Left side of locket
    Label 2: Right side of locket
    Instructions: Upload clear, well-lit photos of your pet.

How to set add-on pricing for Text box fields

You can set add-on pricing for optional Text box fields. This lets you charge buyers for text-based customizations, such as embroidery, engraving, or custom messages.

For example, if you offer embroidered names on a sweater, you can create an optional Custom options field and charge an additional $5 when a buyer enters a name.

If you use variations to charge for text-based customizations, consider switching to an optional Custom options field with add-on pricing instead. This lets buyers enter personalization details and see the add-on price in one place.

How to set an add-on price for a Text box field

Add-on pricing is only supported for optional, text-based Custom options fields. Setup and management are available on Etsy.com. Add-on prices are displayed in your shop currency automatically.

  1. Go to Shop Manager and select Listings. Select the listing you want to update.
  2. Under Item options, go to Custom options. 
  3. Select Add field, then Text box, or edit an existing text box.
  4. Mark the field as optional, then enter a price in the Add-on price field.
  5. Publish your changes.

To remove an add-on price, enter $0 in the Add-on price field and publish your changes.

Pricing requirements

Add-on prices must:

  • Be between $0.20 USD and $500 USD equivalent, based on your listing currency
  • Be entered as a numeric value

How buyers see add-on pricing

When a buyer selects a field with add-on pricing, the add-on price is automatically added to the item price. Buyers see the updated total before checkout. The total, including the add-on price, also appears in buyer receipts and order details, as well as seller order details and order management views.

How to photograph personalized listings

Listing images help buyers understand and choose personalization options. Use clear, well-organized visuals to guide buyers through their choices.

Whenever possible, show real, finished items so buyers know what to expect. You may include examples of similar personalized items you’ve previously made, especially to demonstrate options like colors or styles. Be sure to note in your description that these are examples. 

You can include mockups or digital images in additional listing photos to show personalization options. Make sure text is easy to read, with strong contrast and clear fonts. 

For personalized commercial items (such as engraved or monogrammed products), your primary image must show a finished, personalized item similar to the final product. Do not use blank product images or mockups with placeholder text (ex. “Your Text Here”) as the main image. See Listing Image Requirements for more information.

Displaying personalization options in images

When displaying personalization options in images: 

  • Clearly label each personalization option shown in your images
  • Make sure image labels match the options available in your fields 
  • Consider dedicating one image per field so buyers can easily compare choices
  • Ensure text in images has strong contrast and uses an easy-to-read font

When to offer personalizations, variations, or custom listings

Personalization (in Custom options)

  • Buyers enter custom text or information.
  • The input doesn’t impact your product inventory levels.
  • The input contains personalized details for made-to-order items.

Examples of personalization include a name to be engraved, a custom message on a card, and a preferred font or embroidery thread color for a personalized clothing item.

  • Get a buyer’s phone number: If you need a buyer’s phone number for shipping purposes, contact them via Messages.
  • Prompt a buyer to acknowledge they are ordering a digital item: Etsy has taken several steps to address buyer confusion around digital items. Items are marked as Digital Download underneath each digital listing on search results pages, and in the Item details on the listing page. On the Etsy app, buyers see Instant Download on the listing image. 

Variation

  • Buyers choose from a set list of variants of the base item.
  • Each option affects inventory, price or SKU.
  • Stock is tracked for each variation. 

Examples of variations include size, base item color, and material of a clothing item.

Custom listing

You can offer custom listings in your shop by enabling custom order requests. If a buyer requests a custom item, you can convert their request to a custom listing.

  • Buyers submit a request for a one-of-a-kind item based on their specific vision or preferences.
  • The item is for a particular buyer only, so the listing is private and created directly from the original Custom Request Message thread.

Examples of custom listings include a unique sculpture commissioned by a buyer, and a welcome sign for a wedding created to meet a buyer’s specific vision for aesthetic, materials, and more.

results.name: How Printed Items From Digital Purchases Work for Sellers
results.title: How Printed Items From Digital Purchases Work for Sellers
results.body:
Etsy is testing a new way for buyers to turn eligible digital files they purchase on Etsy’s website into printed items. If you have eligible digital listings, they may be included in this test automatically. You can opt out if you don’t want your eligible listings to be included.

How does the printed item experience work?

After purchasing an eligible digital file, buyers may see an option to order it as a printed item through a separate checkout on Etsy. Buyers can choose from available options, select the digital file they want to use, preview the item, and place a separate order.

Ventur Editions, a third party print provider, sells and fulfills the printed item from their shop:

  • The printed item has its own listing and reviews.
  • If there’s an issue with the order, Ventur Editions provides support.

Are my listings eligible?

Your digital listings may be included in the test if: 

  • Your shop based in the US or Canada
  • You don't already offer a physical version of the design or use your own print-on-demand integration
  • The file meets the print partner’s requirements for high-quality printing

Can I opt out?

If you don’t want your eligible digital listings included in the test, you can opt out. Once you opt out, the option to order printed items will no longer appear after purchases of your eligible listings. For this test, the opt-out applies to your shop rather than individual listings.

Opting out removes print options from being surfaced after purchases of your eligible listings. It doesn’t prevent buyers from independently accessing Ventur Editions’ services with the content they’ve downloaded. 

To opt out:

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Shop Manager.
  2. Select Settings.
  3. Select Options.
  4. Go to Allow buyers to purchase digital prints and select Disabled.

results.name: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
results.title: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
results.body:
The Etsy marketplace connects people looking for unique goods with independent sellers around the world. Everything listed for sale on Etsy must either be made, designed, handpicked or sourced by you. All items sold on Etsy must also follow our Prohibited Items Policy.

It is your responsibility to make sure your shop and its items are in compliance with Etsy's policies. The images you use in your listings must also comply with our Listing Image Requirements. Before buying or selling on Etsy, please review our Terms of Use.

Reselling mass-produced items is not allowed on Etsy. We allow limited exceptions for creative items that are handpicked or sourced by sellers. Learn more about what is allowed.

Learn more about Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Jump to a section:

  • Made by a seller
  • Designed by a seller
  • Handpicked by a seller
  • Sourced by a seller
  • Prohibited items
  • AI-generated content
  • Listings that violate Etsy's Intellectual Property Policy
  • Services or rentals
  • Metaphysical services or items
  • What happens if I find a listing that violates Etsy's policies?

Made by a seller

Items that fall under "Made by a seller" are physical items that are made by you, the seller.

Any items made by you, the seller, must:

  • Be physically made by hand, or produced using computerized tools like a 3D printer, CNC or Cricut machine
  • Only include handcrafted items, hand altered items, hand assembled items or items produced using computerized tools
  • Use your own photographs in your listings

Read Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Can I resell handmade items?

Reselling is not allowed in the Handmade category on Etsy. Reselling on Etsy means listing an item as handmade when you, the seller, weren’t involved in designing or making that item. Learn more about reselling on Etsy. 

Designed by a seller

As a seller, you can offer your original design as a digital download, or use a third party to produce or print your design onto a physical item. This category also includes seller-prompted AI creations. 

Digital items listed in your store must be made and/or designed by you, the seller. Digital items can either be premade files, or files you custom make and deliver to the buyer after purchase. 

Learn more about how to manage digital listings. 

Seller-prompted AI creations must disclose the use of AI. 

If you work with a production partner, you must disclose that production partner in your relevant listings.

Handpicked by a seller

Items that fall under "Handpicked by a seller" include vintage items that are at least 20 years old, items from nature, and certain collections of items that a seller selected and curated for sale.

Learn more about selling items curated by you in Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Sourced by a seller

Items that fall under "Sourced by a seller" enable buyer creativity, like craft supplies, party decorations and items personalized with a buyer's unique text or image.

Learn more about what can be sold in this category in Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Prohibited items

Several types of items are prohibited from being sold on Etsy, including:

  • Alcohol, tobacco, drugs, drug paraphernalia, and medical drugs
  • Certain animal products and human remains
  • Dangerous items, including hazardous materials, recalled items, and weapons
  • Hate items, including items that promote, support, or glorify hatred
  • Illegal items, items promoting illegal activity, and highly regulated items
  • Internationally regulated items
  • Pornography and mature content
  • Violent items, including items that promote, support, or glorify violence

Learn more about prohibited items.

AI-generated content

Etsy allows sellers to use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to create certain items, as long as they contribute their own creative input and follow Etsy’s policies. Sellers must disclose within their listing description if an item is created with the use of AI.

Sellers are allowed to use their original prompts in combination with AI tools to create the products they sell on Etsy. Permitted examples might include a fantasy scene based on a seller’s original prompt and produced by an AI generator, or a custom portrait of a buyer’s pet generated using AI tools. 

Some forms of AI-generated content are not allowed on Etsy, including:

  • Bot-generated content
  • AI-generated functional instructions, such as craft patterns, recipes, and instructions
  • AI prompt bundles

Learn more about Etsy’s stance on AI creations.

Listings that violate Etsy's Intellectual Property Policy

As a venue, Etsy isn’t in a position to offer legal advice or determine whether your shop content infringes someone else’s intellectual property. 

If you're not sure if your item(s) infringe someone’s intellectual property, you can contact the intellectual property owner or consult an attorney. 

If Etsy receives proper notice of intellectual property infringement, we will comply with our policy and remove the specified material.

Services or rentals

In general, services, including rentals, are not allowed to be sold on Etsy. Only services that produce a new tangible item that meets our Seller Policies may be sold on Etsy. 

Learn more about the services that may qualify to be sold on Etsy.

Metaphysical services or items

Metaphysical services, such as reiki and spell casting, are prohibited on Etsy. With this in mind, tarot or psychic readings that include a physical or digital copy of said readings (e.g., a recording, email, or tarot spread photo) may be sold on Etsy. 

Supplies related to spell work, such as herbs, crystals, candles, and tinctures, may be sold on Etsy as long as they are not listed with metaphysical claims. 

What happens if I find a listing that violates Etsy’s policies?

You can report a listing that appears to violate our policies. Etsy may review and/or remove any listings that violate our policies.

results.name: How to Create a Listing
results.title: How to Create a Listing
results.body:
Before you can create a listing, you must register as a seller. Review our Seller Policy to make sure your items fit into Etsy’s handmade, vintage, or craft supply categories.

  1. Sign in and go to Shop Manager.
  2. Select Listings.
  3. Select Add a listing.
  4. Fill in the relevant information in the listing creation form. 
  5. When you’re finished, select Publish. The listing is now live in your shop.

  1. Go to Listings. 
  2. Select + in the top right corner and choose Copy an existing listing or Start from scratch. 
  3. Select a category that best describes your listing. If you don’t see a good match, choose Select a different category to see more options. 
  4. Upload photos and/or videos that show off your item. You’ll be able to edit your uploads later in the process. 
  5. Enter relevant and required information for your listing. Select Next and Back to navigate between sections.
  6. When finished, select Publish.

Once published, it may take up to 48 hours for your listing to appear in Etsy search results and categories.

If you’d rather save the listing for later, select Save as Draft instead. 

Learn how to copy a listing to create multiple listings at once. 

There are 7 tabs in the listing form you must fill out before you can publish.

Jump to a section:

  • Photo & video
  • Category
  • Item details
  • Item options
  • Pricing & shipping
  • How it's made
  • Settings

Photo & video

You can add up to 20 photos and 2 videos that are 5-15 seconds in length to each listing. Select Edit to adjust the image thumbnail, crop the photo to the aspect ratio of your choosing, or delete the photo. Select Apply when finished. Learn about best practices for images in your Etsy shop.

Category

Based on the photos and/or videos you provided, this section will be prefilled. Confirm the selections are correct, and make updates as needed.

  • Find a category: The category determines which sections of Etsy’s marketplace your item appears in. Type the category of your item into the search bar, then under Results, select the option that is the closest match for what you’re listing.
  • What type of item is it?: Select whether you’re listing a physical item or digital files.
  • When was it made?: Select when you made the item you’re selling.

Item details

This is what shoppers see when browsing for items on Etsy, so be sure to follow best practices for getting your items found in search. From here you can add:

  • Title: A listing’s title can be up to 140 characters long. Consider using less than 15 words when including the traits that make your item special. Clearly state what the item is and any key details. Avoid repetition as well as subjective words (for example, “perfect”). There’s no need to add information about price or shipping to your title. Only include holidays, special occasions, or recipient types if they’re essential to what the item is (for example, “Halloween costume”). 
  • Your listing's unique URL is based on the title you enter when you first publish the listing. Once you've published the listing, the URL won’t change again, even if you edit the title later. If you make major changes to your listing, consider creating a new listing so the URL better reflects what's being sold.
  • Digital files: Add up to 5 files for buyers to download when purchasing a digital item from your shop. This section only appears if you have indicated you are listing digital files.
  • Description: Describe the details of your item so buyers know what they’re getting. When possible, include keywords buyers would use when searching for an item like this. Learn about best practices for listing descriptions.

Item options

  • Variations: Add variations to your listing if you’d like to offer different options for the item, like size or color. You’ll only be able to add variations to an item once you’ve selected a category for the item in the Details section. Variations are unavailable for digital listings. Learn how to add variations to your listings. 
  • Personalization: Select Add Personalization if you want to offer the ability to customize your item. Then, add in any personalization instructions you want buyers to see, set a limit on the number of characters a buyer can request when customizing the item, and select if you want to make personalization optional or mandatory for this item. Learn more about personalization.
  • Attributes: Give details about the qualities of the item, such as the color, material, size dimensions, etc. The attributes listed under this section will change depending on the category you selected. Learn more about how to use attributes for your listings.
  • Tags: Add up to 13 tags that describe your item. Try to include keywords buyers would use when searching for an item like this. This helps your item appear in shoppers’ search results. Learn how using tags can help you get found in search.

Pricing & shipping

Price and inventory

  • Price: Set the amount buyers will pay for your item here. The price will appear in your preferred currency. When you enter a price on a listing, a profit estimate appears. This can be either a single price or a range, depending on your variation settings. Select the dropdown to see more details.
  • Quantity: Add the amount of the item you have for sale. Learn more about how item quantity works with listing fees.
  • SKU: Create a custom SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) number for the item to help keep track of your inventory.

Shipping, processing, and returns

Apply accurate processing and shipping information to your listings so buyers have realistic expectations on when the order will arrive. If the listing is for a digital item, buyers will download the files you uploaded immediately after purchase. 

  1. While creating your listing, go to Processing profile.
  2. Select Create.
  3. Select if your item is Made to order or Ready to ship.
  4. Choose the processing time from the How much processing time do you need? dropdown.
  5. Select Apply.

  1. While creating your listing, go to Processing and shipping and select Processing profile.
  2. Select Create new.
  3. Select if your item is Made to order or Ready to ship.
  4. Choose a time from the Processing time dropdown.
  5. Select Save.

If you already have processing profiles, Etsy will pre-fill this section for you. 

  1. Go to Processing profile.
  2. Select Change profile. 
  3. Select Apply on the processing profile you wish to use, or select Create new to add another.

  1. Go to Processing and shipping.
  2. Go to Processing profile and select the pencil icon to edit. 
  3. Select the processing profile you wish to apply and select Save. To add a new processing profile, select Create new.

Learn more about processing profiles.

  1. In the Shipping option section, choose Select Profile. 
  2. Choose one of your existing shipping profiles and select Apply or fill in the required information to create a new shipping option. For calculated shipping, you must enter the item weight and item size (when packed).
  3. If the item will be sent with an international shipping label, you can enter the Tariff Number to prefill a customs form.

Select Change if you need to apply a different shipping profile to your listing. You can also select the three dots next to a shipping profile to Edit or Duplicate it.

GPSR manufacturer and safety information

If you’re a “trader” selling to European Economic Area (EEA) states or Northern Ireland (NI), you may need to include manufacturer and safety information to comply with the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR). 

If you’re listing a physical item, you can also provide Customs information that is used to prefill a customs form when you purchase an international shipping label on Etsy.

How it's made

These are the most basic aspects of your listing, including who made the item, what it is, and when it was made. Add any production partners involved in the creation of this item.

Settings

Adjust settings to how your listing appears and how it will renew.

  • Shop section: Select which of your shop sections you want the listing displayed in or create a new one. Learn more about how to organize your listings with shop sections.
  • Feature this listing: Switch the toggle button on to display the listing at the top of your shop’s homepage.
  • Renewal options: Choose if you want your listings to automatically renew after they expire, or if you’d rather renew them manually. See our policy page to learn more about listing fees.

Questions about listings?

Ask the Community

You can edit all parts of a listing at any time. There's no cost to edit a listing.

If you’re having trouble creating or editing listings, select an issue to learn how to resolve it:

If you find your listing isn’t renewing properly, or says it Needs Review when you are making edits, you’ll need to clarify some parts of your shipping preferences. 

Etsy requires sellers from all origin countries to provide an estimated delivery date to save a shipping profile and listing. 

For each listing, you will need to have the following information completely filled out:

  • Domestic shipping service
    • If Other is selected, you must provide a delivery time.
       
  • Cross-border shipping service
    • If Other is selected, you must provide a delivery time.
    • Cross-border services will be required of all sellers in all countries who ship internationally.
  • If you offer shipping upgrades, shipping service or delivery time.
  • Origin ZIP/postal code/postcode/PIN, which the ioptem is shipping from
  • A processing time to indicate how long you need to get an order ready and handed off to your shipping carrier. Learn how to set a processing time.

You are required to add the above information to listings/shipping profiles whenever you:

  • Create a new listing
  • Duplicate a listing
  • Edit an existing listing
  • Create a new shared or custom shipping profile
  • Duplicate a shipping profile
  • Edit an existing shipping profile

Your image may be too small or too large

We recommend your images be at least 2000 pixels wide. You may want to use image editing software to resize your images before uploading them to Etsy.

Files bigger than 300k may time out, especially on a slower internet connection. Try using a smaller file or compressing your file to reduce its size.

If you are seeing the error message “Listings look best with photos at least 2000 pixels wide”

This error appears when the images uploaded to a listing are less than 2000 pixels wide. While this error is only a suggestion and you should be able to continue publishing, having your listing images be at least 2000 pixels wide will result in better quality images for buyers.

If you’re experiencing a different issue with image uploads, check the steps in this Help Center article.

You can create a new variation type by selecting Create a new variation from the Add or Edit variations popup window. However, buyers won’t be able to filter their Etsy search results based on custom variations.

For example, if you want to offer a unisex size variation, you can choose Create a new variation and type in “Size.”

This is normal, and you'll see the variations and price differences you added when you publish your listing. Try publishing your listing. You can see how buyers can interact with variations from the published listing.

If you’re a seller outside the US and India, you can set up a different listing price for orders shipping within your country and orders shipping outside your country. Learn more to set up domestic & global pricing.

Everything listed for sale on Etsy must be handmade, vintage, or a craft supply. Items sold on Etsy must also follow our Prohibited Items Policy.

Handmade items

Handmade items are items that are made and/or designed by you, the seller. If you sell handmade items, you must:

  • Physically make or create the original designs for your items.
  • Include each person involved in making your items or running your business in the About section of your shop. If you work with a production partner, you must disclose that production partner in your relevant listings.
  • Use your own photographs in your listings.

Read our full Handmade Policy.

Vintage items

Vintage items must be at least 20 years old. Newer, vintage-style, or collectible items aren’t allowed in this category.

Learn more about selling vintage items on Etsy.

Craft supplies

Craft supplies on Etsy are tools, ingredients, or materials whose primary purpose is for use in the creation of an item or special occasion. Craft supplies may be handmade, commercial, or vintage. Party supplies may also be sold as craft supplies.

Learn about what can be sold as a craft supply.

If your listing was removed by Etsy for a violation of Etsy’s policies, check your email inbox for a message from Etsy. In the email you received about this listing(s), you’ll be told the reason it was removed.

If you’re unable to locate an email about your listing:

  • Make sure you’re using the email address registered with the shop that the listing was associated with
  • Check your spam or junk mail

Also be sure to review Etsy’s policies to ensure that your items can be listed on our marketplace. 

You can deactivate or delete a listing from your Listings page. Check the box next to the listing, then choose Deactivate or Delete. If you deactivate a listing, you can reactivate it later. If you delete a listing, it is permanently deleted.

results.name: How VAT Works on Digital Items
results.title: How VAT Works on Digital Items
results.body:
Etsy collects and remits VAT on digital items purchased by buyers located in certain countries.

VAT stands for value-added tax. It's a tax based on the consumption of goods and services that are commonly found in the EU and select other regions of the world.

VAT is also known as JCT, GST, HST, SST, PST, RST or QST in some countries and regions.

VAT may be charged to buyers on their purchases (“VAT on Items Sold on Etsy”) as well as to eligible sellers on their paid seller fees ("VAT on seller fees”).

The information below is for VAT rules on the sale of digital items delivered via automatic download to buyers in:

  • Armenia
  • Australia
  • Bosnia
  • Canada
  • Chile
  • Colombia
  • Egypt
  • the EU
  • Georgia (country)
  • Ghana
  • Kazakhstan
  • Kyrgyzstan
  • Iceland
  • India
  • Indonesia
  • Kenya
  • Malaysia
  • Mexico
  • Moldova
  • Morocco
  • New Zealand
  • Nigeria
  • Norway
  • Peru
  • Phillippines
  • Saudi Arabia
  • Serbia
  • Singapore
  • South Africa
  • South Korea
  • Switzerland
  • Taiwan
  • Tanzania
  • Thailand
  • Türkiye
  • Uganda
  • Ukraine
  • the United Arab Emirates
  • the United Kingdom
  • Uzbekistan
  • Vietnam

This does not apply to physical goods. Learn how VAT works on physical items.

Etsy and digital VAT

Buyers—not Etsy or Etsy sellers—pay VAT as part of their total purchase price when buying digital items.

If you sell digital items, no matter where your shop is located, buyers located in countries on the list above will be charged VAT.

If you sell digital items to buyers in Canada, learn when your buyers will be charged Canadian taxes.

Some examples of digital items:

  • E-books 
  • Digital patterns 
  • Downloadable PDFs

In all cases, Etsy will take the VAT paid by the buyer and remit to the relevant tax authorities. Sellers are not responsible for adding VAT to their digital listing prices. If you have any questions regarding your tax liability on digital items that you sell, please contact your tax advisor.

How digital VAT works for buyers

Etsy automatically detects if the buyer is in one of these countries and adds the appropriate VAT to the listing price if the item is a digital file download.

Buyers see the total price with VAT included on each listing that applies, as well as in their cart, invoice, and purchase page.

Buyers will pay the listing price and VAT for digital items purchased from any seller.

Digital VAT and your Payment account

Etsy Payments

For transactions where Etsy Payments is the payment method, Etsy will automatically collect VAT from the buyer. The VAT will be deducted from the order before the funds are placed in the seller’s Payment account.

Standalone PayPal 

For transactions made with the seller's stand-alone PayPal account, the VAT costs are added to the seller’s Payment account.

Remember, Etsy can't directly collect the VAT charged to buyers when they make a payment to the seller's own PayPal account. If a seller accepts payment in their own PayPal account, applicable VAT will be added to the seller’s Payment account once the buyer completes checkout. This way, Etsy can then remit it.
