results.title: Newly Crafted: Etsy Updates for Your Shop
results.body:
We know you want tools that save time, simplify your day-to-day tasks, and make it easier to grow with confidence—and we’re continually improving Etsy to support those needs.

This page highlights recent features, tools, and improvements for sellers. It’s updated periodically to give you a quick overview of what’s new. Some updates may not be listed here. For more information on what’s new at Etsy, check Etsy News, the Etsy Forums and Site Updates in the Seller Handbook.

Jump to a section:

  • September 2026
  • June 2026
  • March 2026

September 2026

Updates to help make your shop easier to run

More ways to create and manage listings

We’ve been improving the listing experience to help you spend less time on setup, collect the information you need from buyers, and manage your listings more easily. Updates include:

  • Create listings faster with the quick list form: Spend less time on repetitive setup while creating your listing. We’re testing a new form that suggests titles, tags, attributes, and more for your review and edits based on the photos and descriptions you provide. We’re testing this feature with a limited number of sellers and gradually expanding access.
  • Get more control over custom options: Create and manage personalized listings more easily with improvements to custom options fields (formerly called personalization). Charge for personalized text, reuse custom options across listings, make bulk changes, and manage custom options on the web or in the Etsy Seller app.
  • Add a third variation: Add up to three distinct variations, like size, color, and style, to make choices clearer for buyers and reduce the need for follow-up messages or custom instructions.

Create and update listings

 

Shared access to your shop

As your shop grows, you might get help from a family member, business partner, or seasonal assistant. We’ve heard from sellers that you want a better way to share the work of running your shop, so we built shared access with that feedback in mind. 

Invite team members to sign in with their own Etsy accounts so they can help manage your shop while you keep control of your account and sensitive financial information.

Learn more

 

A clearer view of your finances

We’ve updated your payment account to give you a clearer view of your finances, from sale to payout, without the extra digging. You can now:

  • See a detailed breakdown of your balances: Your payment account now separates your current, pending, and total balances, and includes your deposit status. This helps you quickly see what's available now, what’s still processing, and whether anything needs your attention before your next payout.
  • Track fees and earnings together: Sale-related fees stay grouped with the earnings from that sale instead of being deducted right away, giving you a clearer view of what you'll receive from each order.
  • [Coming soon] Find transaction statuses faster: Your transaction history will be organized into total, current, and pending tabs, so you can quickly track the status of your transactions.
  • [Coming soon] Understand your sales at a glance: Each sale in your transaction history will be expandable to show a breakdown of its associated fees and other details.

Learn more

 

Expanded listing appeals

If you believe a listing was removed in error, an appeal gives you the opportunity to ask Etsy to review the decision, share additional context with our team, and potentially restore your listing. 

We’re expanding listing appeals across more policy areas and to more sellers. By the end of 2026, all sellers will have access to appeals across most policy areas. 

Before creating a replacement listing for a removed item, review your appeal options on the Policy Violations page.

Review your appeal options

 

Easier Etsy Ads management

Managing a large Etsy Ads catalog is getting easier. If you advertise a large number of listings with Etsy Ads, you can now use ad groups to organize them around what matters to your business, like best-selling or new listings.

Add multiple listings to an ad group at once, then filter by group to manage and track their performance in one place.

Manage your ads

 

Ongoing improvements to the Community Hub

We're continuing to improve the Community Hub based on seller feedback, including usability updates and platform enhancements. Recent changes are outlined in the Community Hub Release Notes. We encourage you to continue sharing your feedback about the Hub through our survey.

View release notes

 

Updates to support your shop's growth

New ways to understand your shop and plan what’s next

We’ve been improving your stats and insights tools to help you understand what’s happening in your shop, learn more about what buyers want, and decide where to focus next. Here’s what’s new:

  • Get faster, more dependable shop stats: We’ve made improvements so your stats load faster, traffic data refreshes sooner, and you can more reliably access your full history of stats, even if your shop has a high volume of data.
  • Compare your key metrics side by side: We’re introducing new graphs in your shop stats that let you compare visits, orders, conversion rate, and revenue over the same time period, making it easier to spot changes and trends. This feature is rolling out gradually, so availability may vary as we expand access to more sellers.
  • Explore personalized recommendations in Marketplace Insights: See search terms that are relevant to your shop and frequently searched by buyers. Use these recommendations to connect your existing inventory to what buyers are searching for or get ideas for new listings you might add. This feature is currently being tested and may not be available to all sellers.

  • Dig deeper with Stats assistant: We’re expanding the beta of our AI-powered Stats assistant, which uses your shop data to provide personalized answers to questions about your stats. Ask what may be behind a slowdown in sales, explore what’s working well, or get suggestions on where you might focus next as you grow your shop. Don’t have access yet? Let us know if you’re interested in trying the expanded beta.

     

More ways for shoppers to discover your shop

We’re introducing new shopping experiences designed to help buyers discover relevant items and learn more about the sellers behind them. Updates include:

  • More local discovery: New search options let shoppers find items that ship from their area, including a Ships from [Country/City] filter and a Support makers near you option that appears when searching on Etsy.com desktop–making it easier for local shoppers to discover your shop and listings. 

  • A closer look at your shop in search: Enhanced seller previews–including your name, shop name, Etsy tenure, sales, and shop location–give buyers more context about who you are and what you make, right from search results.

     

A new way for buyers to enjoy digital items after checkout

We’re testing an experience that lets buyers turn eligible digital purchases into physical prints, sold, printed, and fulfilled by a third-party print-on-demand provider, on Etsy. 

After purchasing select digital items, buyers can choose from available print options and complete a separate checkout for the physical item. You won’t be responsible for producing or shipping the order.

The goal is to make it easier for buyers to enjoy your digital designs, without adding fulfillment work for you.

Eligible sellers are included in this test automatically. You can opt out any time. 

Updates to help make your shop easier to run

Expanded Etsy Purchase Protection coverage

Based on seller feedback, we’ve updated Etsy Purchase Protection to give you clearer expectations and stronger support when issues happen outside your control. Changes include: 

  • Coverage up to $250 USD for eligible orders, even when the order total is higher
  • Refreshed eligibility guidance
  • More human review for complex cases

Learn more

 

Detailed policy violation information

We've added more detailed information to the Policy violations page so you can better understand why a listing may have violated Etsy policies. With clearer explanations and additional context, you can make informed updates to get your listings back on track and better understand how to stay compliant with Etsy's policies going forward.

Learn more

 

Tariffs estimator

We've added a tariffs estimator in the listing form’s Price and inventory section to help you plan pricing for US buyers with more confidence. The tool lets you estimate potential tariff costs, compare shipping options, and review possible HS codes without leaving Shop Manager. By bringing these resources together in one place, you can spend less time researching and make more informed pricing decisions.

Learn more

 

New requirements for US-bound orders

To help create a more consistent and reliable experience, we’re updating our Seller House Rules for orders shipped to the US. Starting July 9, sellers outside of the US will need to account for all of their costs, including duties and import fees, to US buyers upfront in their pricing and ship with Delivery Duty Paid (DDP). If orders are shipped without duties prepaid, they will no longer qualify for Etsy Purchase Protection.

Learn more

 

Etsy Seller app updates

Updates to the Etsy Seller app help you take care of more shop tasks in one place, so you can keep orders moving and stay on top of your shop. New features include:

  • Shipping label scanner: Use your phone's camera to scan the barcode on a shipping label purchased on Etsy and instantly open the matching order on the app, helping you spend less time searching and more time fulfilling orders.
  • Refunds: Issue full or partial refunds directly from the Etsy Seller app. Before submitting a refund, you'll see a breakdown of how it affects the order, helping you make informed decisions.
  • More detailed order views: Switch to a detailed order view to see key information at a glance, including gifting details, country-specific tax information, and buyer notes. You can also message buyers, add notes, make updates, and print order details directly from the order page, helping you manage orders and buyer communication from one place.

Download the app

 

More quick actions in Messages

New tools in Messages help you resolve buyer issues faster. You can now more easily create return and replacement labels while in a conversation, view more detailed delivery information, and use suggested message drafts to quickly update buyers on their delivery status. Some of these features are also beginning to roll out in the Etsy Seller app.

Check your messages

 

Listing thumbnail previews

You can now preview listing thumbnails before publishing, making it easier to see how your photos will appear across Etsy. By spotting cropping issues before a listing goes live, you can optimize your images for discovery and help buyers get a better first impression of your items.

Preview your thumbnails

 

Custom options for personalized orders

We've improved custom options to help you collect personalization details before an order is placed. If you've used personalization in the past, you'll now find these settings under custom options in the listing form. Gathering information upfront can reduce follow-up messages, help prevent misunderstandings, and keep personalized orders moving smoothly from purchase to fulfillment.

Add custom options

 

Two videos per listing

You can now add a second video to your listings on your desktop or mobile browser, giving buyers more opportunities to understand what makes your item unique before they purchase. Use multiple videos to showcase details, demonstrate how an item is used, or share how it's made. More context can help buyers shop with confidence and make more informed purchase decisions.

Add videos

 

Refreshed look for seller tools

You may notice visual updates across Shop Manager and the Etsy Seller app, including refreshed icons, typography, and colors. These updates create a more consistent experience across Etsy's seller tools and lay the groundwork for future improvements.

 

Ongoing improvements to the Community Hub

We're actively improving the Community Hub based on seller feedback, with ongoing usability updates and platform enhancements. Recent changes are outlined in the Community Hub Release Notes. We encourage you to continue sharing your feedback about the Hub through our survey.

View release notes

 

Updates to support your shop's growth

AI-powered tools built to support sellers

Your creativity is what makes Etsy unique. We’re continuing to invest in AI-powered tools designed to help you better understand your shop, save time, and make informed decisions so you can focus on creating and growing your business.

Recent updates include:

  • Shop stats summaries: We're testing AI-powered key takeaways in Shop Stats that highlight trends in your performance data and factors that may be influencing results. This feature is rolling out gradually, so availability may vary as we expand access to more sellers.
  • Expanded AI-powered support: Through the support chat experience, quickly get answers to common account, payments, marketing, and listing questions, or find relevant Help Center resources. As part of our ongoing investment in seller support, support chat helps you get answers faster and allows our support team to focus on more complex issues when you need hands-on assistance.
  • Attribute suggestions for listings: Etsy now suggests attributes based on listing details, such as category, description, and the featured image you've already entered, helping you create more complete listings more quickly and provide buyers with clearer product information.
  • Stats assistant: We're testing a new stats assistant tool designed to make it easier to understand your shop performance and get personalized suggestions for your shop right from Shop Manager. You can ask the AI-powered stats assistant questions about your performance and get insight into what's working, what might need attention, and areas you could focus on next. This feature is currently being tested and may not be available to all sellers. Interested in trying the beta version of the stats assistant? Sign up to be considered for early access.

These tools are designed to help you better understand your shop, make informed decisions, and save time. Seller feedback continues to shape how we build and improve these experiences so they solve real business needs in ways that feel useful, trustworthy, and in your control.

Learn more

 

Interested shopper offers

Reach 2x more potential buyers on average with new Interested shopper offers than with other targeted offers alone.* Once set up, Etsy automatically sends offers to eligible shoppers who have engaged with your listings. By reaching interested shoppers at the right moment, you may encourage them to return to your shop and complete a purchase.

*Based on an internal analysis of Etsy visitor data across all platforms (app, mobile web, and desktop) from March 18–April 17, 2026.

Set up the offer

 

Promo code redemption controls

New redemption controls give you more flexibility when sharing promo codes publicly. Set limits on how many times a code can be redeemed or restrict buyers to a single use per code. These controls make it easier to share your codes on social media and other channels with confidence. Be sure to communicate redemption limits to buyers so they know what to expect.

Create a promo code

 

Redesigned Offsite Ads dashboard

The redesigned Offsite Ads dashboard gives you a clearer view of how Offsite Ads are contributing to shop traffic and sales. See revenue, fees, visits, top-performing channels, and listings in one place. You'll also be able to track traffic generated by Offsite Ads even when it doesn't lead directly to a purchase, helping you better understand how buyers discover your shop.

Go to your dashboard

 

Etsy Ads strategies for listings

With a $25+ daily budget, you can now choose Etsy Ads strategies for individual listings, giving you more control over how they’re promoted. Use listing-level controls to tailor your advertising strategy based on your business goals such as investing more in top performers or reducing spend on lower-priority items.

Learn more

 

New Marketplace Insights metrics and capabilities

We're testing Marketplace Insights features that can help you identify trends, understand buyer behavior, and make more informed business decisions. Updates include:

  • Extended date ranges: Analyze data across 30 days, 90 days, or 12 months to identify trends and opportunities over time.
  • Listing price ranges: See price ranges based on listings buyers have recently purchased for search terms.
  • Search conversion rate: Understand how often a search term leads to an order.

These features are currently being tested and may not be visible to all sellers.

Explore Marketplace Insights

 

Balanced review insights

We're making review highlights more balanced by showing both positive and constructive themes from buyer reviews. Giving buyers a fuller picture of customer experiences can help them make more informed decisions and build confidence in their purchases.

 

Expanded payment methods

We’ve expanded the ways buyers can pay on Etsy, making it easier for more shoppers around the world to complete their purchases using the payment methods they know and trust. New payment methods include:

  • Revolut (available in UK, France, Ireland)
  • Swish (available in Sweden)
  • TWINT (available in Switzerland)
  • Bizum (available in Spain)
  • UPI (coming soon to India)

Updates to help make your shop easier to run

Simpler shop settings

Shop settings are now grouped more intuitively to help you manage your shop confidently and create a strong first impression. There’s clearer context about how fields—like your About section, process videos, and team information—appear to buyers. This is the first phase of improvements to shop management and will roll out gradually to all sellers.

 

Faster, easier listing creation

Listing form sections are now organized more clearly, with shortcuts that help you find what you need faster. To help you save time, some fields may be prefilled based on your existing listings—review and edit them to ensure accuracy. We’ve also removed the Materials tag field since this information is already captured in the Materials attribute field. 

Learn more

 

Smarter order management in the Etsy Seller app

We’ve updated the Etsy Seller app to help you manage and fulfill orders more efficiently and deliver a more personalized experience:

  • Improved filters and sorting: Redesigned filtering and sorting tools help you find orders by status, ship-by date, destination, personalization, gift status, and more.
  • Buyer order history: View a buyer’s past orders and message history directly from the order details page to personalize your service.
  • Gift marking: If a buyer needs to mark their order as a gift after checkout, you can now make this update directly in the app.

We’re working on even more Etsy Seller app updates to simplify managing your business on the go.

Download the Etsy Seller app

 

Quick refunds and cancellations in Messages

We’re continuing to enhance Messages to make it easier to take order-related actions without leaving a conversation, saving you time and helping you resolve buyer issues faster. You can now issue refunds and cancellations from within Messages, with more quick actions coming soon.

Learn more about Messages

 

Clearer billing and payment management

We’ve refreshed the Make a payment page for a more seamless experience. Add or update your payment methods, view saved methods, and manage autobilling preferences directly without being redirected to Settings.

Learn more

 

Stable listing URLs for better discovery

Listing URLs now remain fixed after a listing is first published. Stable URLs help off-Etsy search engines find, understand, and surface your listings, so more buyers can discover them outside of Etsy. Redirects now only occur when a listing is permanently retired.

Learn more

 

Pricing transparency for UK buyers

To help sellers comply with the UK Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers (DMCC) Act, Etsy now displays the total item price, including shipping, throughout the shopping experience for UK buyers only. This creates a more transparent shopping experience.

Learn more

 

Updated review rating calculation

Ratings now reflect your full history on Etsy, while giving more weight to recent reviews. This approach gives buyers a more holistic view of your shop while ensuring your recent item quality and customer service have a stronger influence on your rating.

Learn more

 

Ongoing improvements to the Community Hub

We’re actively improving the Community Hub based on seller feedback, with ongoing usability updates and platform enhancements. Recent changes are outlined in the Community Hub Release Notes. Some features are only available when logged in—sign in to explore the full experience. We encourage you to continue sharing your feedback about the Hub in this survey.

View release notes

 

Updates to support your shop’s growth

More ways to get discovered with AI shopping

Buyers in the US can now discover and/or purchase eligible Etsy items within AI platforms where they’re already searching and shopping—like ChatGPT, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Google Search, and Microsoft Copilot. Learn how Etsy uses AI to support sellers.

Learn more

 

Enhanced search tools in Marketplace Insights

We created the Marketplace Insights tool last year to help you identify keyword opportunities and understand search trends. As we continue improving the tool, we’re testing updates to make tracking trends and refining your listings even simpler:

  • Week-over-week trends: Quickly see whether buyer interest in a search term is rising or falling week over week, so you can adjust listings or inventory based on demand.
  • Saved searches: Save up to 50 searches to easily revisit and monitor keywords over time.
  • Similar search term sorting: Sort keyword ideas by search volume or number of listings to compare opportunities.
  • Improved keyword ideas (English only): Discover more relevant and creative related keyword ideas to help you identify new search terms to target. Use thumbs up or down to help improve suggestions. 

These features are currently being tested and may not be visible to all sellers.

Learn more

 

Targeted offer performance at a glance

Performance metrics for targeted offers are now visible directly in Sales and discounts. The new table shows key data like offers sent, purchases, conversion rate, and revenue per offer, so you can see what’s working and plan your next promotion with confidence. 

 

A smoother checkout experience

We’ve improved the checkout experience to make it easier for buyers to complete their purchases. Buyer payment options have expanded to include Pay by Bank (UK), and guest buyers can now use Apple Pay directly from listing pages. We’ve also streamlined checkout navigation and payment selection.

We’re committed to regularly improving your experience with updates like these—and we’re also hard at work building new tools and features to help you grow. We’d love to hear how these updates are working for you. Let us know in a short survey.

results.title: How to Purchase an Item On Etsy
results.body:
When you buy on Etsy, you're supporting a small business by purchasing from an individual seller.

To purchase an item on Etsy, find an item you’re looking for, add it to your cart, and complete the checkout process. This guide will help you get started. 

Did you receive an Etsy gift card? Redeem a gift card and learn how to pay with it.

Jump to a section:

  • Find what you're looking for
  • Complete the checkout process
  • After you complete your order

Find what you’re looking for

If you need a little help finding your next purchase, here are a few tips:

  • Check Editors’ Picks for items hand-picked by Etsy staffers.
  • Go to Gifts to browse giftable items for different personalities, tastes, and celebrations. Learn more about buying gifts on Etsy.
  • Use the Etsy search bar and filter for items on sale, shop location, color, and more. Learn more tips for searching on Etsy.
  • Check shops’ reviews, policies, badges, and shipping times to help guide your decision.
  • If you’re shopping for someone else, consider an Etsy gift card so your recipient can purchase exactly what they want. Learn how to buy a gift card.

What if I find items I love, but I’m not ready to buy them?

To keep track of items you love on Etsy, you can add them to your Favorites by selecting the heart icons on listings. You can also curate collections of your favorites that you can return to anytime, like shopping lists. 

Learn how to keep track of your favorite items and shops.

Complete the checkout process

Once you’ve found the perfect item, complete your purchase by checking out on either Etsy.com or the Etsy app. You can sign in or create an Etsy account, or check out as a guest.  

Learn how to use a coupon code or make an offer. 

When should I use “Buy it now”? 

Use Buy it now when you’re purchasing a single listing and you want to check out quickly. You’ll just need to add the quantity of items from the listing, verify your payment method and shipping information, and select Place your order. 

When should I use “Add to cart”? 

Choose Add to cart if you want to purchase more than one listing, apply a coupon code, or add a note to the seller with instructions.

  1. To quickly purchase a listing, select Buy it now. Otherwise, choose Add to cart.
  2. In your cart, you can Edit or Remove items, or Save for later. You can also Apply a coupon code.
  3. Select Proceed to checkout. If you have multiple items in your cart but only want to purchase one, select Check out for this shop only. 
  4. Verify your shipping address and shipping method. Select Ship to if you’d like to choose a different saved address, or add a new one. 
  5. Select Payment to verify your payment method or add a new one. If you have an Etsy gift card or credit, you can redeem it here. 
  6. Once everything looks correct, select Place your order. 

  1. To quickly purchase a listing, select Buy it now. Otherwise, choose Add to cart.
  2. Select View in your cart. Here, you can Edit or Remove items, or Save for later. You can also Apply a coupon code.
  3. Select Go to checkout. If you have multiple items in your cart but only want to purchase one, select Check out from shop. 
  4. Verify your shipping address and shipping method. Select Ship to if you’d like to choose a different saved address, or add a new one. 
  5. Select Payment to verify your payment method or add a new one. If you have an Etsy gift card or credit, you can redeem it here. 
  6. Select Proceed to checkout.
  7. Confirm your order details and select Place your order. 

  1. Add an item to your cart.
  2. In your cart, you can Edit or Remove items, or Save for later. You can also Apply a coupon code. 
  3. Select Proceed to checkout and then Continue as a guest.
  4. Enter your shipping address, verify your shipping method, and select Continue to payment. 
  5. Select your payment method. You’ll need to sign in to an existing Etsy account or create a new one if you want to use an Etsy gift card or credit. 
  6. Select Review your order. 
  7. Once everything looks correct, select Place your order. 

Learn more about using guest checkout.

Card declined? Learn more about resolving a declined card.

If you’re shopping internationally, learn how currency conversion works on Etsy.

What other information do I need to add when I check out? 

If you’re giving a gift, select Mark order as gift for options such as gift messages, a gift preview email for your recipient, and gift wrapping when available. Learn more about gift-giving on Etsy.

Are there special checkout requirements for my location? 

You may have some extra steps in the checkout process depending on where you live. 

If you're in the EEA (EU, Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein) you may be asked to authenticate your payment after you select Place your order. Respond to a prompt from your card issuer and provide additional information. This may be a password, a passcode, or an answer to a question.

If your shipping address is located in India, you’re prompted to enter your phone number during checkout. Your order confirmation message is then sent to you via WhatsApp and your email. If you don’t have WhatsApp on your phone, you’ll receive the confirmation via SMS. To opt out of future order confirmation texts, select the unsubscribe link in the message.

When you download a digital item on Etsy, you give up your right to a cancellation under EU consumer laws. You’ll need to check a box to acknowledge this before completing your purchase.

After you complete your order

Etsy will send you an email for each shop you purchased from. If you have any questions about your order, be sure to reach out to your seller directly.

Find your order on your Purchases page. If you purchased as a guest without signing in, your order will appear here if you connect it to an account. Learn how to connect a guest order to an account.

Where do I find my digital purchase?

If you purchased a digital file that's available for instant download, you can download the file from your Purchases page. You’ll also receive a separate email with a link to view and download your files on Etsy. 

If you purchased as a guest, you'll find a download link in your email receipt. Learn more about downloading a digital item.

What if my order doesn’t arrive on time or has a problem?

You can shop confidently with Etsy's Purchase Protection. For qualifying orders, get a full refund if your purchase doesn’t arrive on time, arrives damaged, or doesn’t match the item description or photos.

Quick answer

The best way to get help with an order you already placed is to contact the seller:

Contact seller

If you have a question about an item, the seller is the best person to answer questions about an item. Select Message the Seller on a listing page or Contact under the seller’s photo on their shop homepage.

Select an issue for help:

Enter descriptive terms in the search bar on the top of Etsy.com to start your search. For example: “rustic blue coffee mug,” or “custom charm necklace.”

You can change the order of your search results with the Sort by option above the search results.

On the left side of every search results page, you’ll see a list of filters to narrow down your results by.

Learn more about searching on Etsy.

Learn about buying gifts on Etsy.

  1. Find the items from the shop you have a promo code for. If you’re buying items from more than one shop, your cart will be divided up by shop.
  2. Select Apply shop coupon codes.
  3. Type or paste the code into the box.
  4. Select Apply.

Your coupon code applies only to the shop that offers that coupon. Shops are run by individual sellers, who manage their own promotions. Coupon codes are available at the seller's discretion and can expire at any time.

If your payment was declined, check each of these issues:

  • Double check the card information for your order: Make sure that your billing address and expiration date are up-to-date.
  • Authorize the transaction with your bank: Your bank may flag any unexpected activity on your account. Check with your bank to see if they flagged the transaction.
  • Check that you're within your daily withdrawal limit: Most banks have limits on how much money can be charged or accessed in a single day. Your bank may require you to request a higher purchase limit to complete the transaction.
  • Register your prepaid credit card: If you're using a prepaid credit card or gift card, register your personal information with the card issuer before checking out.
  • If you're in the EEA: Check your security authentication answer. To authenticate a payment, you may need to respond to a prompt from your card issuer and provide additional information. 

If none of these solutions worked, you may need to use a different payment method.

Buyers in the US

If you don’t see the option to pay with Klarna and you’re in the US, try these steps:

  •  
    • If the order is between $250 USD and $10,000 USD you’ll need to sign in to an Etsy account or create an Etsy account to check out with Klarna.
    • Check that your region setting is correct. Check that your language is set to English, currency to USD, and region to United States. 
    • The item or order value may not be between $50 USD and $10,000 USD before discounts, shipping and taxes (unless the total is $10,000 after discounts).
    • If an item is below $50 USD, combine it with more items in your cart to total over $50 USD.
    • If you still don’t see the option to pay with Klarna, the shop may not accept Klarna installment payments at this time.
    • If Klarna declines your transaction for an order over $250.01, it may be because you didn’t pass Klarna’s credit check. In this case, you can complete your order using a different payment method.
    • You can’t use Klarna to purchase an Etsy gift card, and you can’t combine Klarna payments with an Etsy gift card.

Learn more about paying with Klarna.

Buyers in Germany

If the seller ships your order within 21 days of checkout, the Klarna invoice is sent 5 days after the date it was shipped. If the order isn’t shipped within 21 days, the Klarna invoice will be issued 22 days from your purchase date.

Please do not pay your invoice via direct bank transfer to the seller, you must pay the invoice amount to Klarna.

If your order has been cancelled and you received an invoice nevertheless, please contact Klarna first.

Buyers in the UK

If you don’t see the option to pay with Klarna and you’re in the UK, try these steps:

  • If the order is between £50 GBP and £1,000 GBP, you’ll need to sign in to an Etsy account or create an Etsy account to check out with Klarna.
  • Check that your region setting is correct. Check that your language is set to English (UK), currency to GBP, and region to United Kingdom. 
  • The item or order value may not be between £50 GBP and £1,000 GBP before discounts, shipping and taxes (unless the total is £1,000 after discounts).
  • If an item is below £50 GBP, combine it with more items in your cart to total over £50 GBP.
  • If you still don’t see the option to pay with Klarna, the shop may not accept Klarna installment payments at this time.
  • You can’t use Klarna to purchase an Etsy gift card, and you can’t combine Klarna payments with an Etsy gift card.

Learn more about paying with Klarna.

If you're not seeing the option to pay with iDEAL, make sure your default account currency is set to Euro (EUR) and your default region set to the Netherlands.

If you weren’t redirected back to Etsy after completing the transaction on your bank’s website, your order may not have completed.

Your bank account may be charged but the order won't be registered on Etsy. An automatic refund should have been processed when this occurred. These refunds typically take up to 5 business days to appear back in your bank.

If you are having trouble redeeming your Etsy gift card, check the following:

  • Make sure you’re signed into your Etsy account with the correct email address. 
  • Double-check that you’re entering the correct redemption code.
  • Check to make sure  that you haven’t already used the balance of your gift card in your Etsy account by going clicking You, then Gift card balance.

If you continue to have trouble redeeming your Etsy gift card, click I still need help and include your redemption code in your request.

My gift card balance isn’t being applied to my order

Only shops that accept Etsy Payments can accept Etsy gift cards.

To find shops that accept gift cards, search for an item on Etsy and check Accepts Etsy gift cards on the left side of the search results page.

Each seller on Etsy chooses their own payment methods and policies. Contact the seller if you have any questions about their options.

results.body:
Message to Buyers is a short note you can include in the receipt page and order confirmation email that your buyers receive after purchasing from your shop.

Consider using your message to thank your customer for their purchase, inform them about standard shipping practices, or provide any other information you think they may need to know.

To add or edit your Message to Buyers on Etsy.com: 

  1. Sign in and go to Shop Manager.
  2. Go to Settings.
  3. Select Info & Appearance. 
  4. Go to Message to Buyers and enter your message.
  5. Select Save Changes.

If you sell digital items, include a Message to Buyers for Digital Items. This message is included on the Downloads page for digital orders. It applies to all digital listings purchased from your shop. 

You can also send other messages to buyers about their order. Learn more about Messages.

results.name: How to Offer Custom Items
results.title: How to Offer Custom Items
results.body:
Enabling custom order requests shows buyers that you can work with them to create  one-of-a-kind items beyond what you have available in your inventory. If a shopper requests a custom item, you can convert their request to a custom listing. 

How to enable custom order requests

You'll be able to add custom order requests once your shop is open to the public. Custom order requests can only be enabled on Etsy.com.

To enable custom order requests:

  1. Go to Shop Manager.
  2. Go to Settings.
  3. Go to Options.
  4. Under Custom order requests, select Enabled.
  5. Select Save.

A Request Custom Order button will appear on your shop homepage. 

The maximum processing time you can place on a custom order is 6-8 weeks.

What your buyer will see

When a buyer chooses Request Custom Order, they'll be able to send you a message describing what they're looking for and the date they need it by (if there is a deadline).

If you need more information, send your buyer a message to work out the details.

How you and your buyer complete a custom order

When the buyer initially requests an item, you'll receive a message. If it’s a new message, it will be in your Custom Requests folder. If it’s part of an existing message thread, it will be in your Inbox. 

Once you work out the details of exactly what the buyer wants and how much it will cost, create a custom, private listing directly from the original Custom Request Message thread.

It's not possible to choose a calculated shipping profile for custom orders at this time.

Additional information about custom listings

  • The listing won't appear in your public shop or in search, which means that other buyers won't be able to purchase it. Once your listing is sold, though, it will appear on your public Sold Items page with your other sold listings.  
  • Your private custom listings are viewable from your Listings page. They’ll be labeled Private. 
  • Once you publish this listing, we'll send your buyer an email with a button to purchase the listing. 
  • Private listings cannot be created for digital items. If you want to offer a custom digital item, consider setting up made-to-order digital listings in your shop.
  • If your buyer sent the request through a regular message, you can still create a private custom listing. In the message, select Create custom order. Fill out the required information, then choose Send private listing.

How custom listings differ from listing variations

Listing variations offer an item you already make, with different options a buyer can choose from, such as color, size, styles, or materials. These options are available for any buyer who visits your website to purchase. 

Listings created from a custom request are private between you and the buyer. When a custom listing is created, that item is only available for the buyer who made the request and won’t be displayed on your storefront. 

Learn more about using and managing custom orders.
